metadata.frozen_stem_policy: first encoder stem; normalization statistics follow training policy

generator.name: native_conv
generator.description: Resample, project at native scale, then align

utilizer.name: sk
utilizer.adaptation: SK Fuse/Select on externally generated branches. Pooled BN omitted for batch-one support; hidden size configurable. No original SK split kernels.
utilizer.normalization: softmax over branches per channel; no normalization in pooled MLP
utilizer.output: one fused B,C,H,W tensor; no residual head

complexity.scope: one inference forward including encoder, generator, utilizer and all output heads
complexity.convention: MACs: dense convolution and tensor contractions; FLOPs: 2*MACs; other operations estimated separately
complexity.convolution: dense padded kernels; transposed kernels counted at input spatial positions, including subsequently cropped positions
complexity.estimates: scalar arithmetic/comparison/transcendental operations each cost 1; interpolation excludes internal coordinate/index computation
complexity.exclusions: IO, transfer, memory movement, integer indexing, backward and optimizer; no claim of hardware-exact FLOPs

coverage.note: Call coverage is not a fraction of FLOPs; full classification still uses documented estimates/exclusions.

aten.add_.Tensor.rule: one scalar operation per output element (alpha multiply adds one)

aten.batch_norm.default.rule: running variance add+rsqrt per channel; center/scale; optional affine multiply/add

aten.conv2d.default.rule: batch*spatial*weight.numel; input spatial for transpose; bias adds separate

aten.div.Tensor.rule: one scalar operation per output element (alpha multiply adds one)

aten.gelu.default.rule: erf GELU 5 or tanh GELU 9 scalar operations per element

aten.layer_norm.default.rule: mean/variance and normalization ~7 operations/element; affine adds 2

aten.mean.dim.rule: reduction inputs-outputs operations; mean adds output divisions

aten.mul.Tensor.rule: one scalar operation per output element (alpha multiply adds one)

aten.relu.default.rule: one scalar operation per output element (alpha multiply adds one)

aten.relu_.default.rule: one scalar operation per output element (alpha multiply adds one)

aten.sigmoid.default.rule: negation, exp, add, reciprocal each cost 1

aten.softmax.int.rule: max, subtract, exp, sum, divide; optional log; 1 cost per scalar

aten.sub.Tensor.rule: one scalar operation per output element (alpha multiply adds one)

aten.sum.dim_IntList.rule: reduction inputs-outputs operations; mean adds output divisions

aten.upsample_bilinear2d.vec.rule: 4 weighted samples: 4 multiplies+3 additions/output; internal coordinates excluded

protocol.timed_scope: device tensor to all heads, including deep/region/edge; excludes IO/transfer

complexity_protocol.scope: one inference forward including encoder, generator, utilizer and all output heads
complexity_protocol.convention: MACs: dense convolution and tensor contractions; FLOPs: 2*MACs; other operations estimated separately
complexity_protocol.convolution: dense padded kernels; transposed kernels counted at input spatial positions, including subsequently cropped positions
complexity_protocol.estimates: scalar arithmetic/comparison/transcendental operations each cost 1; interpolation excludes internal coordinate/index computation
complexity_protocol.exclusions: IO, transfer, memory movement, integer indexing, backward and optimizer; no claim of hardware-exact FLOPs

protocol.interpretation: Execution diagnostics only; random input/weights cannot establish COD quality or learned branch utility
